subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only A sits to the left of D. Only four people sit between A and C. Only B sits between G and F and G is not an immediate neighbour of C. How many people sit to the right of G?
solution:
Persons: A, B, C, D, E, F, G (7 persons)

All facing North

Only A sits to the left of D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a2624e83a55626c095287b705949557588108a700b7aa8b7d4764e0cc786c4.png] 

4 persons between A and C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aa1d8cdb65c54acb8e312959b9c0e65ead51c51cb0a4de05f0c6d964bf5e4ba.png] 

Only B between G and F

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/061d81f4447349d6c8a76acf45e800ede2d350904e7b5a09a3ed00ce698810b8.png] 

G not immediate neighbour of C

 Remaining positions

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d4726cff9b799a994d85d01be202f0ef981fc72456cb9037f1e60bfd3bbc66e.png] 

 

A D G B F C E

People right of G:

B, F, C, E = 4

**∴ 4 people sit to the right of G.**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 2.**
